subject.title: feat(config): journal every config change with source labels and manual-edit detection

question: Should this phase guarantee a complete, chronologically reliable journal for all supported config write shapes—including top-level `$include` mutations—or land only a deliberately narrower root-file journal first?
rationale: The PR’s advertised operator contract is broad, while the remaining include and attribution gaps are architectural boundary choices rather than isolated cosmetic fixes.

options.title: Complete the journal contract
options.body: Require complete origin attribution, route include-owned writes through the journal, and record reconciled external edits before replacement writes.

options.title: Narrow phase-two scope
options.body: Document and expose this as a root-config-file audit only, defer include coverage and complete attribution to an explicitly approved successor.

recommendation.title: Complete the journal contract
recommendation.body: Require complete origin attribution, route include-owned writes through the journal, and record reconciled external edits before replacement writes.

likelyOwner.reason: The related phased design and the proposed implementation both originate from this feature owner.
